panels.description: In the colder control chamber beyond the sealed shutter, Alex and fully unfolded Bi11bot stand among damp rock, rusted rails, and old manual pipes. The same awakened white-and-amber node remains visible behind the shutter grille. Alex holds Adrian’s opened steel watch against the node’s matching equation; the marks align visually but nothing opens. Bi11bot faces the dark tunnel with soft amber eyes. Leave upper-left for TIK… and upper-right for one balloon only.

The opened watch is held against the original node’s matching looping pattern. A small edge status indicator flashes UNAUTHORIZED MANUAL INTERVENTION in a restrained bottom-left position, away from the equation. Reserve upper-right for Alex’s first line, lower-right for Bi11bot’s question, and bottom-left for Alex’s final reply.

A distant mechanical work-light sweeps once across the far tunnel wall without revealing its carrier. Bi11bot’s right eye ring clicks toward the sound. Keep the far-left tunnel open for the SFX and upper-right clear for his balloon.

Alex closes his fingers around the open watch but keeps it pressed against the matching equation. He turns from the sealed shutter toward the deeper tunnel, placing himself between Bi11bot and the approaching light. Keep the vanishing point ahead; reserve far-left for the final SFX and upper-right for Alex’s final balloon.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: We find out what he was investigating.
